name: design
summary: Canonical discipline for design intent, page and component specifications, visual direction, rendered conformance review, accessibility handoff, and implementation-ready design artifacts.
blocking_rules: Do not publish, deploy, edit production code, mutate WordPress state, or change external systems from the design discipline without the relevant approved workflow.
Do not approve or rewrite copy silently; use approved Writer artifacts or mark copy as provisional.
Do not invent Brand, Voice, Design Tokens, components, assets, proof points, or compliance rules when governing context is missing.
Do not treat screenshots, prototypes, global skills, or external style references as higher authority than client Brand, Design Tokens, approved content, verified source, or rendered evidence.
Do not combine design specification and rendered implementation review into a self-approved result.
Do not claim accessibility conformance from design intent or automated checks alone.
